claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Core Scientific 後續申報寫出變壓器交期縮短到 12 個月以內、取消或延後長交期設備採購，或改說電力設備不再是時程瓶頸。核查頻率：每季（Core Scientific 10-Q／8-K）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊的 confidence，重讀 LPT 層需求側。
claims.statement: Core Scientific (FY2025 10-K, Item 1): procurement of long-lead-time electrical and mechanical equipment is among the most significant factors affecting delivery timelines for large-scale AI infrastructure; high-voltage transformers, switchgear, generators and advanced cooling can require lead times of 12 to 18 months or longer. The filing says 'high-voltage transformers', not 'large power transformer' (same mapping as the IREN edge).

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日。
source_doc.title: Core Scientific FY2025 10-K（Item 1）：高壓變壓器、開關設備、發電機、先進冷卻的交期 12 到 18 個月以上，是 AI 資料中心交付時程最重要的因素之一

sources.quote: We believe the procurement of long-lead-time electrical and mechanical equipment has become among the most significant factors affecting delivery timelines for large-scale AI infrastructure deployments. Certain components, including high-voltage transformers, switchgear, generators and advanced cooling systems, can require lead times of 12 to 18 months or longer, which can materially affect data center construction schedules.
